units: <cite ref="Chagigah 15a:4">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>כי גו׳ דגמלא</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>כגידא</he>) as the boards of a landing bridge are placed side by side (leaving small slits).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a:6">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>דמי לגו׳ דגמלא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לגי׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) like the junction of a landing bridge (which is at first shaky, but,) once put up, grows firmer.—*<cite ref="Gittin 73a">Gitt. 73ᵃ</cite> bought poppy seed, <he>אגידא דנהר וכ׳</he> deliverable at the landing of &c.; v. preced.—Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ top <he>גו׳ דרצועתא</he> the seam of the straps (of the phylacteries). V. <cite ref="C00627"><he>גִּידָא</he></cite>.
